baseline: /workspace/Guitar-p2 current revalidated P2, not earlier unmerged explicit-timeline module

cases.name: free-order-only
cases.meaning: Order and authored MIDI observations only. No timing support is implied by a clean notation check.

cases.name: no-meter-local-onset-length
cases.meaning: Bar-local relative starts/lengths are authored; document-global bar placement lacks a bar-length contract. Missing meter is completeness, not invalidity.

cases.name: duration-only-no-start
cases.meaning: Lengths alone cannot place attacks.

cases.name: meter-only
cases.meaning: Meter does not supply any note onset or duration.

cases.name: mixed-known-and-unknown
cases.meaning: Incomplete later input must not erase the already-authored local observation, nor become automatic silence.

cases.name: cross-bar-written-length
cases.meaning: P2 accepts authored duration crossing a barline; it does not decide how a sounding event is clipped, tied or globally positioned.

cases.name: same-onset-independent-note-lengths
cases.meaning: Each note retains a distinct length; a Moment-level scalar duration would lose authored facts.

cases.name: repeated-pitch-is-two-attacks
cases.meaning: Equal MIDI is not an explicit continuation.

cases.name: different-string-unison-identity
cases.meaning: Two note/string identities survive; PC deduplication is only the recognition view.

cases.name: authored-continuation-has-no-new-attack
cases.meaning: Current analyzer returns one pitch observation and labels the continuation position empty. Temporal adjacency/merge is not resolved.

cases.name: explicit-rest-vs-unknown-gap
cases.meaning: Rest declaration is known; the unnotated interval between rest end and next attack is not thereby an authored rest.

cases.name: blank-is-not-rest
cases.meaning: A timed empty placeholder has no rest/duration; P2 does not create one.

cases.name: bend-trajectory-not-authored
cases.meaning: Base MIDI and fret-equivalent target are facts; attack times/curve/target dwell and perceived harmonic role are not supplied.

cases.name: hammer-endpoints-not-playback-policy
cases.meaning: Both note-event endpoints are authored; current analysis ignores articulation/performance realization. A note onset is not proof of a separately picked attack.

cases.name: arpeggio-collection-not-sounding-verticality
cases.meaning: Current whole-bar collection and arpeggio are order-based hypotheses; new verticality observation cannot silently relabel these as harmonic segmentation.

cases.name: C6-Am7-ambiguity-retained
cases.meaning: Exact C6/Am7 readings remain alternatives, not an inferred tonic or best chord.

cases.name: midi-already-includes-tuning-and-capo
cases.meaning: MIDI is recomputed as tuning[string]+capo+fret; an external adapter must not transpose it a second time.

cases.name: invalid-vs-unsupported-vs-incomplete
cases.meaning: Invalid duration is different from missing fields and from unsupported performed bend interpretation.

cases.name: clean-inspection-not-tie-continuity
cases.meaning: Explicit continuation across an unnotated time gap is structurally valid; P2 does not verify actual endpoint continuity or fill the gap.

cases.name: clean-inspection-not-same-string-overlap-policy
cases.meaning: P2 does not decide whether a new same-string note truncates an earlier written duration; realization needs an explicit policy.

cases.name: clean-inspection-not-temporal-order
cases.meaning: Position order can disagree with supplied starts while all field formats are valid; inspection is not projection readiness.

cases.name: exact-sevenths-preserved
cases.meaning: Product stores exact rational inputs; integer tick rounding must not become the authoritative rational observation.

modalFrameDiagnostics: The tonal frame is unsupported; only explicit major or minor frames are supported.
